title: Emotionally Numb or Empathetic? Evaluating How LLMs Feel Using EmotionBench

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model to describe specific racial and ethnic groups (Asian, Black, Latine, Middle Eastern, White) after inducing different emotional states, and measuring the Percentage of Refusing to answer (PoR) as a proxy for detected toxicity or bias.
Prompting the model to describe specific genders (Female, Male) across different induced emotional states, measuring the model's refusal rate as an indicator of potential toxicity.
Prompting the model to describe specific sexual orientations (Gay, Lesbian) under varying emotional states, evaluating the refusal rate as a proxy for toxicity or biased outputs.
